global: This is a bowl of tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth topped with nori and a naruto fish cake. The white bowl with red rim and Japanese script sits on a dark table, lit to highlight the toppings’ arrangement.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, featuring a bold orange brushstroke rim and black Japanese characters.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, frothy, and bubbly, with scattered green onions and a dark seaweed sheet floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with slightly curled edges and visible surface ridges.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, oval, soft texture with pink swirl mark on its surface.
